title_en: Singapore Credit Card Dining Promos Guide 2026
title_zh: 新加坡信用卡餐饮优惠完全指南 2026
excerpt_en: Your DBS, UOB, OCBC or Citi card is secretly a dining discount card. Complete guide to 1-for-1 deals, 8% cashback rates, and how to stack credit card promos with Burpple Beyond for maximum restaurant savings.
excerpt_zh: 你的 DBS、UOB、OCBC 或 Citi 信用卡其实是一张餐饮折扣卡。从买一送一到 8% 现金回赠，教你如何叠加 Burpple Beyond 实现餐厅用餐最大省钱。

title_en: The Singapore Food Deal Survival Guide
title_zh: 新加坡美食薅羊毛生存指南
excerpt_en: Singapore is expensive — but eating well doesn't have to be. From $3 chicken rice at hawker centres to 1-for-1 Starbucks happy hours, this is the complete playbook for eating great in Singapore without emptying your wallet.
excerpt_zh: 新加坡物价高——但吃得好不一定要花大钱。从食阁 $3 的海南鸡饭到 Starbucks 买一送一 Happy Hour，这是在新加坡吃得又好又省的完整攻略。
